subject: Action needed: Supplier ledger enrollment, PO-field mapping & EFT proofing
messages:
From: FinX AP <accounts@finxcorp.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Maya Torres <maya@helixretail.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier enrollment request for Helix Retail (PO routing / EFT)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking our call earlier. Helix is ready to add Redwood as an approved supplier in our FINX supplier ledger so we can process the onboarding PO and set up EFT remits. Before we create the supplier record, AP needs the following: 

- Completed vendor registration form (legal name, tax ID, remittance address)
- Bank account confirmation (voided check or bank letter)
- PO field mapping: which Redwood field we should populate as the 'supplier_code' and whether the PO number should be referenced in invoice header or invoice lines
- VAT handling: Helix is EU-facing on some SKUs — they asked whether Redwood can include VAT breakdowns on invoices when required

Can you confirm a point of contact and send the registration packet? Also include any requirements for split-payment remits (i.e., remit-to vs billing-to). Attached is our supplier request template (FinX portal will also ask for a sample invoice).

Attachments: finx-supplier-request-template.xlsx (XLSX stub)

Best,
--
FinX AP Team
accounts@finxcorp.com

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
To: FinX AP <accounts@finxcorp.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier enrollment request for Helix Retail (PO routing / EFT)

Hi team — thanks for the note. Attaching Redwood's supplier onboarding packet and a sample PO mapping CSV to speed intake. Quick answers inline to your bullet list: 

- Registration form: attached (redwood_supplier_onboarding_packet.pdf). Please route back completed PDF.
- Bank evidence: we can provide a bank letter (bank-evidence-template.pdf attached). We will redact account numbers when first submitting and provide full proof via secure upload to FINX if required.
- Supplier code: Redwood prefers using 'RWI-GLOBAL' as the supplier_code field. Please confirm if FINX needs a numeric ID; if so we'll provide a secondary numeric token.
- PO number placement: For Helix, best practice is to have the PO number on invoice header (we can include on line items per request). Our invoicing engine supports both; header is default and easiest for AP matching.
- VAT: Redwood will add VAT lines only when the underlying sale is VAT-applicable. For EU transactions where Helix is the importer, we typically issue net invoices and provide self-billing templates where applicable. If Helix requires grossed VAT invoices, please flag the legal entity and tax treatment for those POs.

Next steps we propose: 
1) You create a 'pending supplier' record in FINX with supplier_code RWI-GLOBAL.
2) Once created, send a portal invite for us to upload bank evidence.
3) Confirm whether the portal will accept multiple remit addresses for split remits. If not, we can submit a remit-split instruction file that maps PO ranges to remit destinations.

I've looped in Laura (billing ops) and Ben (payments) to coordinate on the bank evidence and remit split work. Let us know the preferred secure upload link or a DocuSign/FINX portal flow.

Attachments: redwood_supplier_onboarding_packet.pdf (PDF stub), sample-po-fields.csv (CSV stub), bank-evidence-template.pdf (PDF stub)

Thanks,
--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0192

From: Maya Torres <maya@helixretail.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: FinX AP <accounts@finxcorp.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 14:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier enrollment request for Helix Retail (PO routing / EFT)

Thanks — file receipt confirmed. A few clarifying questions from our procurement team: 

1) Remit-split: We will have two remit destinations for some international POs (one EU entity, one US entity). Can you accept a remit-split CSV mapping PO prefix (e.g., HLX-EU-*) to remit account? If so, what columns/format do you require?
2) Supplier code numeric token: FINX prefers a numeric secondary id for backend mapping — can you provide a 6-digit numeric string we can map to 'partner_id' in the ledger?
3) VAT: For POs where Helix is the customer importing goods into EU, we will need a VAT-inclusive invoice with VAT line and VAT rate. Can Redwood produce a converted invoice showing VAT and gross totals for those POs? If not, we'll configure FINX to handle the VAT separately.

One more operational ask: FinX's portal has a required field called 'PO_ack_required' (true/false). If Redwood requires PO acknowledgement for every PO, set to true — otherwise we can mark it false and only require ack for POs flagged 'special terms'.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best regards,
--
Maya Torres
Head of Procurement — Helix Retail
maya@helixretail.com
+44 20 7946 0100

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
To: Maya Torres <maya@helixretail.com>, FinX AP <accounts@finxcorp.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 22 Jul 2028 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier enrollment request for Helix Retail (PO routing / EFT)

Maya / FinX team — quick answers and attachments again for your intake team.

1) Remit-split CSV format: We can accept a remit-split file with columns: po_prefix, remit_entity, remit_account_token, effective_from, effective_to. Attached is sample-po-fields.csv which includes a sample mapping row (HLX-EU-*, Redwood EU, RWI-EU-0001, 2028-07-01, 2099-12-31). If FINX requires a different header name, we can rename columns when uploading.

2) Numeric partner_id: Redwood provisioned partner_id = 003482. Use this in FINX as the secondary id mapped to RWI-GLOBAL.

3) VAT invoices: We can issue VAT-inclusive invoices on a per-PO basis if Helix confirms which POs require VAT grossing. Our billing ops will need PO-level flagging from FINX. Proposed approach: FINX adds 'vat_required' boolean on PO header and includes a 'vat_rate' decimal field; our invoice generator will use those to produce grossed invoices.

4) PO acknowledgements: By default Redwood sets PO_ack_required = false for standard product subscriptions and services. For POs that contain hardware or one-off professional services, we ask that Helix set PO_ack_required = true. If FinX needs a hard true/false, set default false and we will escalate any PO flagged for ack.

Next steps on our side: Laura (billing ops) will follow up to accept the FINX portal invite and upload the bank evidence. Ben will provide the bank letter via the secure upload link. Expect a portal upload within 24–48 hours once the FINX invite is live.

Thanks,
--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0192
